name: Seeed Studio XIAO MG24
description: Silicon Labs EFR32MG24 (78 MHz Cortex-M33) XIAO with 4 MB external flash, Matter over Thread, BLE 5.3, battery charging and 19 GPIO.
notes: A 'Sense' version (separate SKU, $10.99) adds an analog microphone and 6-axis IMU.
1536 KB internal flash plus 4 MB onboard flash; 19 GPIO = 11 side pads + 8 back pads; ceramic antenna with optional external U.FL.
The wiki documents a recovery procedure for boards that appear bricked after entering deep sleep.
Standard 14-pad XIAO footprint (7 per side, 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm row spacing); header coordinates assume the pads are centred on the 21 mm board length.
